title: %sum - total of an array's numeric values
purpose: Reduce an array reference to the sum of its numeric elements.
notes: Takes a single array reference and folds its elements; it is not variadic over scalar arguments.
A whole-number total is emitted as an integer (##); a fractional total stays a number (#).
Point the reference at an object-field array (@.lines.amount) to sum one field across records.

avoid.snippet: total = %sum @.x  (where x is a scalar number)
avoid.why: %sum expects an array; a scalar reference resolves to no array and silently returns #0 rather than the value or an error
